nsight.factor_phase_accounting: PASS: exclusive scopes partition factor envelope on all 32 ranks; numerical status remains FAIL
data_quality: All selected outer NVTX factor scopes agree with direct CSV scopes to less than 0.001 second.
Nsight warns some NVTX events might be missing, so fine-grained launch attribution is approximate.
Each report dropped four or five incomplete CUPTI events at profiling shutdown.
CPU kernel-space backtraces unavailable; user-space backtraces collected.
Only 1.18% to 25.48% of collected factor backtraces reach a known entry frame; unobserved callers cannot be ruled out.

failed_attempt.refinement: First correction finite; residual then grew rapidly, overflowed to infinity and ended with NaNs.
failed_attempt.collection: srun --wait=30 killed Nsight report generation after untraced ranks exited; no nsys-rep files were retained.
failed_attempt.correction: --wait=0 with the existing outer timeout; repeat capped at 30 refinement iterations

methodology: CPU and quiet GPU cases use the same frozen Release executable and native library in one allocation.
Only the selected processes are traced; each shares a GPU with an untraced process.
Running-CPU sample fractions are not wall-time fractions. MPI under ScaLAPACK/BLACS is separate.
Incomplete stacks do not rule out an unobserved ScaLAPACK caller.
CUDA active union is not SM occupancy; host/GPU times can overlap.
Original failed runs are retained and excluded from speed comparisons.
No numerical source or tolerance changes were made for these studies; the profile retry only bounded refinement iterations and fixed report collection.
finding: The quiet GPU repeat also diverged, so Nsight cannot be the sole cause. The underlying numerical cause remains unestablished.
findings: Matched CPU control passes; quiet GPU and both profiled GPU attempts fail accuracy. Do not compute a valid matched GPU speed ratio.
Selected-process factor kernel union is 25.839..44.965 s versus 729.45 s factor wall; GPU occupancy and whole-device utilization were not measured.
Visible CPU hotspots are ButterflyPACK host WY recompression, GPU-factor row gathering, low-rank extraction, all-to-all preparation, MPI and local BLAS.
ScaLAPACK/PBLAS/BLACS outside MPI is directly visible in 0.65..1.35% of collected factor backtraces. Incomplete callers prevent complete ScaLAPACK attribution.

host_wy is a zero-Householder-tau fallback that copies data down, forms a triangular factor using serial CPU loops, and copies results back. This is a measured performance target, not a proven cause of numerical failure.
Numerical correctness must be explained and fixed before further optimization or production speed claims.
